name: Seerr Bridge
overview: Seerr inside Jellyfin: button, embedded view, search and sign-in.
description: Brings Seerr into the Jellyfin web client: a button in the header and side menu, Seerr embedded in Jellyfin instead of a redirect, Seerr suggestions under Jellyfin search results with one-click requests attributed to the right user, optional single sign-on via Quick Connect, and a compatibility bridge for clients that still send legacy X-Emby authorization headers. Settings page is in German; the button label follows each user's language.
changelog: Renamed to Seerr Bridge: Jellyseerr is now Seerr. All labels, descriptions and the menu route (#/seerr) follow the new name. Settings are kept.
